highlights.title: ICE, Trump and Africa: Secret deals, broken lives
highlights.summary: For this edition of Reporters+, Karina Chabour has investigated a dark side of Donald Trump’s immigration policy. How ICE deports immigrants to so-called ‘third countries’ in Africa, far from the United States and often far from their countries of origin.
